# Synthetic N2K fixtures

`everett-pt-townsend.log` is a candump-format log (`(secs) can0 ID#DATA`) generated by
`plotter/tools/synth_n2k.py`. Regenerate it from the repo root with:

```bash
python3 -I plotter/tools/synth_n2k.py --canboat third_party/canboat/canboat.json --out plotter/tests/fixtures/n2k/everett-pt-townsend.log
```

Output is deterministic. Replay it through n2kd:

```bash
build/n2kd/n2kd --replay plotter/tests/fixtures/n2k/everett-pt-townsend.log --speed 0 --stdout --pgns third_party/canboat/canboat.json
```

## Scenario `everett-pt-townsend` (20 minutes, start t=1798000000.0)

- Own ship, source 1, 3.0866 m/s (6 kn) through (47.98, -122.23), (47.99, -122.30), (48.05, -122.45),
  (48.11, -122.75). 129025 and 129026 (COG true, SOG), 127250 (magnetic heading = COG + 0.05 rad,
  variation 0.2731 rad east) and 128267 (depth `30 + 25*sin(2*pi*s/300)` m, offset -0.3 m) at 1 Hz,
  130316 water temperature 283.15 K (instance 0, source sea) every 2 s.
- Dropouts: no 129025 or 129026 for s in [300, 315); no 128267 for s in [360, 372).
- AIS, source 2, every 10 s each, 1 to 2 km off the track, 4 to 8 kn: class A MMSI 367000001
  (129038, 129794 name "TEST TUG"), class B MMSI 367000002 (129039, 129809 name "TEST SAIL"),
  class A MMSI 367000003 (129038 only).

`plotter/tools/test_synth_n2k.py` checks these values through the real n2kd.
